```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

project_root <- normalizePath(file.path("..", ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
master_data_path <- file.path(
  project_root, "data", "intermediate", "scenarios", "full_c5km_v5km_r50km_mInf",
  "master_data_with_travel_cost.parquet"
)

if (!file.exists(master_data_path)) {
  stop("Input data not found: ", normalizePath(master_data_path, mustWork = FALSE))
}

master_ds <- open_dataset(master_data_path)

add_season_dates <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      month = as.integer(format(month_date, "%m")),
      season = case_when(
        month %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
        month %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
        month %in% 9:11 ~ "Fall",
        TRUE ~ "Winter"
      ),
      season_start_month = case_when(
        season == "Spring" ~ 3L,
        season == "Summer" ~ 6L,
        season == "Fall" ~ 9L,
        TRUE ~ 12L
      ),
      season_start_year = as.integer(format(month_date, "%Y")) -
        as.integer(month %in% c(1, 2)),
      season_start = as.Date(sprintf(
        "%d-%02d-01", season_start_year, season_start_month
      ))
    )
}
```

# Monthly Demand

```{r}
#| label: monthly-demand
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

monthly_demand <- master_ds %>%
  group_by(year_month) %>%
  summarise(
    total_visits = n(),
    migrant_visits = sum(migrant_richness > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    resident_visits = sum(resident_richness > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(month_date = as.Date(paste0(as.character(year_month), "-01"))) %>%
  arrange(month_date)

ggplot(monthly_demand, aes(x = month_date, y = total_visits)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, color = "#0072B2") +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Number of Visits") +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
#| label: monthly-migrant-resident
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

monthly_visits_long <- monthly_demand %>%
  select(month_date, migrant_visits, resident_visits) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(migrant_visits, resident_visits),
    names_to = "bird_type",
    values_to = "visits"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bird_type = recode(
      bird_type,
      migrant_visits = "Migrant",
      resident_visits = "Resident"
    )
  )

ggplot(monthly_visits_long, aes(x = month_date, y = visits, color = bird_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Migrant = "#D55E00", Resident = "#009E73")) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Number of visits", color = NULL) +
  theme_classic()
```

# Seasonal Demand

```{r}
#| label: seasonal-demand-data
#| include: false

seasonal_demand <- monthly_demand %>%
  add_season_dates() %>%
  group_by(season_start, season) %>%
  summarise(
    total_visits = sum(total_visits),
    migrant_visits = sum(migrant_visits),
    resident_visits = sum(resident_visits),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(season_start)
```

```{r}
#| label: seasonal-total-migrant-resident
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

seasonal_visits_long <- seasonal_demand %>%
  select(season_start, season, total_visits, migrant_visits, resident_visits) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(total_visits, migrant_visits, resident_visits),
    names_to = "bird_type",
    values_to = "visits"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bird_type = recode(
      bird_type,
      total_visits = "Total",
      migrant_visits = "Migrant",
      resident_visits = "Resident"
    )
  )

ggplot(seasonal_visits_long, aes(x = season_start, y = visits, color = bird_type, group = bird_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%Y-%b") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Total = "#0072B2", Migrant = "#D55E00", Resident = "#009E73")) +
  labs(x = "Year-season", y = "Number of visits", color = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
#| label: seasonal-migrant-share
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

seasonal_share <- seasonal_demand %>%
  mutate(migrant_share = migrant_visits / (migrant_visits + resident_visits))

ggplot(seasonal_share, aes(x = season_start, y = migrant_share, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, color = "#D55E00") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, color = "#D55E00") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%Y-%b") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year-season", y = "Migrant share of visits") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
#| label: seasonal-migrant-resident-difference
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

seasonal_difference <- seasonal_demand %>%
  mutate(difference = migrant_visits - resident_visits)

ggplot(seasonal_difference, aes(x = season_start, y = difference, group = 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, color = "#7B3294") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, color = "#7B3294") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%Y-%b") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Year-season", y = "Migrant visits minus resident visits") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

# Average Visits Per Hotspot

```{r}
#| label: average-visits-per-hotspot
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

hotspot_avg <- master_ds %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster_id), !is.na(year_month)) %>%
  group_by(year_month, cluster_id) %>%
  summarise(visits = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(month_date = as.Date(paste0(as.character(year_month), "-01"))) %>%
  add_season_dates() %>%
  group_by(season_start, season, cluster_id) %>%
  summarise(visits = sum(visits), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(season_start, season) %>%
  summarise(avg_visits = mean(visits), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(season_start)

ggplot(hotspot_avg, aes(x = season_start, y = avg_visits, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, color = "#0072B2") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, color = "#0072B2") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%Y-%b") +
  labs(x = "Year-season", y = "Average visits per hotspot") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
